evidence: Field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM JEOL 6700F) and TEM were used for structural analysis of the samples. TEM samples were prepared by pipetting a sample suspension in ethanol onto a TEM grid. The size measurements were carried out from the SEM images using AnalySIS software (Soft Imaging System), as well as from the TEM images. The DCC of the Au NW arrays embedded in the PAA template was explored by using cyclic voltammetry that was performed in 50 mM sodium nitrate at 100 mV/s with a EG&G PARC M273A potentiostat.
